research_question: 哪些输入影响成功、任务内重试和真实耗时？

stages.priority: 先完成短任务单项对照
手势接口及短任务资格后扩展；长程预算单独冻结

trial_order: 每seed对条件做固定随机置换(seed=20261011)；每次从同一完整初态快照重置并核SHA，条件不得共享可写记忆。
fixed: 实际回执模型/推理档位
同任务提示和成功判据
同任务请求/动作/墙钟预算

budgets.status: 需真实链路资格和可兑现资源后冻结；长程不套用短任务预算

psi_hand_action.library_state: exact user-library path awaits clarification; actual export must bind joint order/limits/presets/synergies and source SHA
psi_hand_action.delta_unit: rad-equivalent at each resultant joint, qualification required
psi_hand_action.whole_arm_control: 末端位移/旋转仍由模型决定；不给现成完整任务脚本

retry_definition.task_retry: 同一子目标失败后重新开始一次执行尝试；第一次不计重试，按独立原生attempt_id及failure→restart事件计数。
retry_definition.registration: Freeze native subgoal events and failure/restart predicates before trials; model-written attempt claims cannot alone create a retry.

metrics: success/attempted registered trials; never count not-run as observed failures
model waiting vs physics vs rendering time
fixed-budget restricted time and time-to-success with failures censored at budget
analysis: 成败用同seed配对差值/discordant counts及区间；费用/恢复先报全部尝试，再报两条件都成功的匹配seed。失败早停不当更快；20是最低起点，小差异可能仍不确定。 Missing wall/request timestamps remain missing with coverage; seconds of model waiting cannot replace full wall time. Replacements retain original IDs and report matching state hashes; until all registered trials are observed the full-registered CI stays null.
failures: 每个预注册ID保留中断/拒绝/超时；若补跑，追加replacement ID并保留原尝试，正式比较至少20个有效匹配初态。
logging: 实际模型可见字段+原PNG SHA、输入文本/图像总量、动作/原生回读、attempt_id与事件、逐请求真实时戳、同步视频与终态；评分状态不给模型。
execution_frontier: 当前无新20初态结果；需要实际手势库绑定、native接入资格与无冲突GPU时段。旧关停链和旧窗口不复用。

input_integrity.camera_deletion: Remove the named camera from all current/history image attachments and any textual pixel observations derived solely from that view. Retain calibration only for remaining cameras. Record actual attachment list, image bytes and SHA.
input_integrity.resolution: Resize all retained RGB consistently with deterministic interpolation; scale pixel-coordinate overlays and intrinsics to preserve the same geometry. Freeze method and resulting dimensions before trials.
input_integrity.bundles: Keep static task/robot/action definitions constant. Dynamic pose, joints, calibration, feedback and memories are separately serialized, with explicit masks on the actual upstream request. No deleted information in summaries, image labels or recovery prompts.
input_integrity.first_step: Not-yet-available feedback/history is recorded distinctly from condition deletion.
input_integrity.model_identity: Bind actual upstream model and effort receipt on every request; a mismatch invalidates comparison and is retained in accounting.
